summary: Frontend-only testing of 5 features via Playwright on the public URL. The Offerings mega-menu works on / and /blogs (3 columns, 10/10 thumbnails load, the panel stays open when the mouse moves into it, closes when the mouse leaves, mega-item-pre-school navigates, the Offerings click goes to /offerings, mega-view-all goes to /offerings). On /shop there is no mega-menu because the shop page uses its own navbar (shop-navbar) with no Offerings link. Mobile 390: the hamburger menu shows a plain Offerings link and no mega-menu renders. /blogs success-stories section renders and the view-all button goes to /success-stories. Pre-school page: stem-lms, stem-about (rb-about-oll with team and media cards) and stem-schools (rb-real-schools carousel with arrows and partner-logo marquee) render styled, with 0 broken images out of 125; hero, modules and final CTA are intact. Robotics & AI page: About OLL and Real Schools render. Curriculum gate passed for both rb-nav-download and rb-curr-download: an empty submit is blocked by native required validation, a short phone shows the custom error, a valid submit closes the modal, the PDF downloads (OLL-Robotics-Beginner-Curriculum-2026-27.pdf) and POST /api/schools/inquiry returns 200 with source robotics-ai-program-curriculum-download. Both leads were confirmed via GET /api/schools/inquiries and then deleted. All 3 legacy CBSE URLs redirect to the new slug and render cbse-ct-ai-landing; canonical is the new URL; the homepage card school-cs-cbse-ct-ai goes to the new URL.

ui_bugs.issue: /shop has its own navbar (shop-navbar: logo, search, cart) with no Offerings link, so there is no mega-menu on /shop. The review request expected hovering Offerings on /shop to work. Either add <OfferingsMegaMenu/> to the shop navbar or confirm this is intended.

issues: The 'View all offerings' pill sits below the white panel, floating over the page content, with no background behind it. It looks detached; consider moving it inside the white card (for example as a footer row).

Only 1 published story exists (test seed 'Aarav Sharma'), and its image is broken (alt text is shown). The section shows a single card with empty space to the right. This is data, not code, but the image fallback could be better.
The autoplay interval (5.5s) is not reset after a manual arrow click, so the carousel can auto-advance right after the user clicks prev/next. Minor UX issue.

action_items: Decide whether /shop should get the Offerings mega-menu; if yes, add OfferingsMegaMenu to the ShopPage custom navbar
Optional: move the mega-view-all pill inside the white panel
Optional: reset the RbRealSchools autoplay interval when the user clicks an arrow
critical_code_review_comments: CurriculumGateModal: fake email lead_<phone>@pending.oll.co is sent to the backend. This is fine for dedupe, but repeated downloads with the same phone create duplicate CRM leads; there is no dedupe.
CurriculumGateModal: downloadPdf runs before the lead POST and the lead POST errors are swallowed silently. That is acceptable for UX, but failed leads are invisible.
CurriculumGateModal: the inputs have the HTML 'required' attribute, so an empty submit shows the browser-native tooltip, not the custom error. This is inconsistent but harmless.
Many leftover TEST_* school inquiries from earlier iterations remain in the School CRM (~70). They were not created this iteration; consider a cleanup.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass except the /shop mega-menu, which is absent because ShopPage has its own navbar)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 School CRM leads ('TEST Gate School Nav', 'TEST Gate School Curr') and deleted both via DELETE /api/schools/inquiry/{id} (200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mega-menu triggers: pill-nav-link-offerings on the homepage pill nav, nav-link-offerings on other pages. The mega-menu is portaled to body (offerings-mega-menu). The gate modal testids use the rb-curriculum-gate-* prefix. The CBSE CT&AI canonical slug is /school/cs/cbse-computational-thinking-ai-books-activities-for-classes-3-to-8.
